description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a Settings page, allowing users to customize app theme, notifications, view account info, and sign out.

classes.name: SettingsPage
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the settings screen where users can modify preferences.

classes.name: _SettingsPageState
classes.description: State class managing the logic and UI of the SettingsPage, including loading preferences and handling user interactions.

methods.name: _loadPrefs
methods.description: Asynchronously loads user preferences for theme and notifications from SettingsRepository.

methods.name: _onThemeChanged
methods.description: Handles theme mode changes, updates preferences, and applies theme via AppThemeController.

methods.name: _onNotificationsToggled
methods.description: Updates notification preference and persists it.

methods.name: _signOut
methods.description: Invokes sign-out from the authentication repository.
